picks.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in September 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 3.5% would limit Federal Reserve rate cuts and erode real wages heading into 2027.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices, shipping costs, and inflation elevated.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state billionaire wealth tax would test whether such taxes raise revenue or push wealthy residents and capital elsewhere.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: OpenAI's IPO valuation will signal whether investors believe heavy AI spending can turn into lasting profits.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership in frontier AI models shapes where investment, talent, and cloud revenue concentrate among a few giant firms.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI-credited solution to a famous open math problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning with broad research implications.
